Subject: Re: Next steps — Redwood evaluation

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the call today — great context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Primary goals you called out: reduce per-inference cost for churn prediction, support 1k QPS baseline, and ensure private data never leaves your VPC.
- Key non-functional asks: SOC 2 evidence, optional HSM/KMS integration, and SLAs on p99 latency for dedicated pools.
- Success criteria for the pilot: sub-$0.001/token cost with under 200ms p50 for typical queries; integration with your feature store by the end of Q2.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Technical deep-dive (45–60m) with your platform and devops leads to walk architecture and run a short live query test.
2) Procurement/security sync to go over SOC2 artifacts, contract timelines, and provisioning requirements.

Please confirm the following so I can calendar: who from Nova should join each call (security contact, procurement owner, devops/platform lead), and which of these slots work for you:
- Tue Apr 14, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Apr 15, 13:00–14:00 PT

I've attached a short summary of our discovery notes and a high-level SOC2 snapshot for reference. If procurement prefers, loop in their mailing list and I'll engage our Contracts lead.

Thanks — I can coordinate invites once you confirm attendees.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Great — confirmed on my side. A few technical prep notes for visibility and to speed the live test:

- Can Nova provide a short dataset (anonymized CSV or S3 path) we can use for a 10–15 min live inference run? Prefer < 1000 rows.
- Clarify whether Nova wants TLS+mTLS or direct VPC peering for private deployment. If mTLS, we’ll need client cert provisioning details in advance.
- If you plan to test HSM-backed keys, please advise which KMS provider (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) and whether we should request a test key.

Attached a brief runbook for the demo sequence (tech-runbook.pdf). If procurement/security prefer not to share any data during the meeting, we can demo using synthetic data.

Mateo
